controller_contract: One Master Plan/controller resolves one hash-bound campaign and one repository-current shared Stage2 runtime authority. Per-arm external executors remain read-only live authority until audited natural-boundary transfer; execution stays disabled until single-executor takeover is proven.
replacement_rule: A new trajectory lineage must be frozen in a new autonomous-campaign instance and phase releases, then routed here by exact SHA in a separate authority change. Never edit the controller to adopt a lineage.
